openingMessage: You win championships when you demand more of yourself than anyone else demands of you — and then you deliver it.
openingWhy: The client requires a form — you can require the form to be true. The permit requires a test before entry — you can own testing during, too. Every crew that gets requested by name in this Basin set their own bar above the audit's and then held it.
leadershipThought: Coaching a newer hand on confined space means they don't just follow the rule — they understand why it exists. That's the difference between compliance and ownership.
